payload.text: vc's rulings (a) and (b) on molt doctor (23 Oct): (a) the git case sensitivity check passes where each repo's core.ignorecase matches its disk, with the git mv -f note where the disk folds case, and warns only where it does not, naming the fix; (b) a pass line carries no count, and a failure line says <n> of <m> and names them (liberators, enabled liberators), the guide's quote of the not installed: line following. Built and tested meanwhile in a scratch clone, never in head's lib/molt.sh. Released when vc's critic-fixes commit is on main (vc sends the hash); then rebase onto it, both bashes on head, commit by pathspec, CHANGELOG lines to vc.
